result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in all seven places you listed. The full offline test suite passes, including a new test for the round-trip.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: `promotion` gets a nullable `description VARCHAR(255)` column after `category`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: the record has a new last component, `String description`, which is null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)` overload. A null or blank description is stored as null, matching how blank categories are handled. The existing 5-argument method stays and delegates with a null description, so current callers and tests are unchanged.
- **`DataStore.java`**: `createPromotion` writes the description. The SELECTs in `findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion` and `listUnusedPromotions` read it, and each row mapping passes it into `Promotion`.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionOfPromotionInListingsAndLookup` test. It creates SUMMER with the description and PLAIN without one, then checks the text through lookup, active-on-date, active-in-region, by-category, best-promotion and unused-promotions. I raised SUMMER to 15% in the test so it wins the best-promotion check over PLAIN at 10%.

Nothing is committed. One note: my first attempt at the `DataStore` edit also changed a `WarehouseCategory` mapping, which broke compilation. I reverted that line, and the diff now touches only the promotion queries.
